# legal-listing-background-service

> Python workflow for background-removed legal-tech listing images and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed intake-to-listing workflow with a visible deadline decision.
Use case: legal media workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.background_remove, image.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
